title: Regional Filter Excludes the Only Multi-State Policy Memo
summary: A school transit query is run with a West-only metadata filter. The corpus contains the correct multi-state program memo, but it is tagged national and disappears before ranking or packing can recover it.
query: Which Clean Transit program lets school districts pool battery grants across states?

dataset.name: Clean Transit incentive packet
dataset.notes: Synthetic policy corpus with one national memo, regional FAQs, board notes, and a vendor explainer.

debugChecklist: Compare pre-filter retrieval hits against post-filter survivors to see whether the gold document vanished.
If the gold document exists but is tagged more broadly than the query scope, inspect the metadata policy before touching ranking.
When the failure is filter-induced, the nearest fix is often relaxing or broadening the metadata constraint.

chunks.label: Memo chunk 1
chunks.text: The GridShare Reserve program lets member school districts pool battery grants across state lines when they procure through a joint transit authority.

chunks.label: West FAQ chunk 1
chunks.text: California and Nevada districts may file separate battery grant applications through the Western reserve track.

chunks.label: East FAQ chunk 1
chunks.text: Eastern districts can stack battery grants with depot upgrades, but the application remains state-specific.

chunks.label: Board note chunk 1
chunks.text: Board members contrasted state-specific reserve tracks with the joint-authority program used by multi-state districts.

chunks.label: Vendor chunk 1
chunks.text: Vendors often call GridShare a pooled reserve, but districts still need the official joint-authority memo to qualify.

chunks.label: Email chunk 1
chunks.text: Mesa Schools asked whether pooling was possible, but staff were told to check the joint-authority documentation before applying.

runs.label: Baseline · region = west

verdict.headline: The correct policy memo was retrieved before filtering, then removed because it was tagged national.
verdict.detail: The filter preserved only West-tagged material. That left FAQs and notes that discuss state-specific applications, so the answer drifted toward the wrong program.

runs.story: The system had the right document in the corpus, but the region policy excluded it before ranking could help.
runs.outcome: The answer names a Western reserve track even though only GridShare allows multi-state pooling.
